name: crossdock
description: Swift and Objective-C language features on Windows, powered by sourcekit-lsp running on your Mac build server over SSH.

crossdock.ssh.host.description: Hostname or IP of the Mac build server.

crossdock.ssh.privateKeyPath.description: Path to your SSH private key (e.g. ~/.ssh/id_ed25519). Leave empty to use ssh-agent. Passwords are intentionally not supported.

crossdock.ssh.hostKeyFingerprint.description: Optional pinned host key fingerprint (SHA256:...). If empty, the key is trusted on first use and refused if it ever changes.

crossdock.ssh.keepaliveSeconds.description: SSH keepalive interval; a dead link is detected after 3 missed keepalives.

crossdock.remoteRoot.description: Absolute path on the Mac where mac-listener mirrors this workspace (e.g. /Users/me/proj).

crossdock.lsp.command.description: Command run on the Mac to start the language server.

crossdock.telemetryFile.description: Where to write connection telemetry for the dashboard. Defaults to .crossdock/crossdock-telemetry.lsp.json in the workspace.

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run bundle
